name: @jskit-ai/assistant-core
description: Reusable assistant client/server/shared primitives without surface-specific routes or settings ownership.

surfaces.summary: Conversation runtime: createConversationRuntime and file or application-owned storage; advanced storage and host contracts are documented separately.
Optional UI: Embeddable conversation element, transcript, composer and progress presentation with application-owned state and actions.
Optional UI: Turn mapping, rich-text parsing, question helpers and scroll-follow state.
Optional UI: Layout-aware scroll-follow operations.
Optional UI: Suggestion state and configuration for an application-supplied, separately authorized generator.
Optional UI: Question extraction and answer selection used by the supplied binding and custom presentation.
Optional UI: Attachment upload and selection state; applications retain storage and authorization.
Optional UI: Optimistic message delivery, immutable retry payloads, failure actions and canonical receipt reconciliation.
Framework integration: Exports reusable assistant UI primitives, HTTP helpers, and client API builders.
Framework integration: Exports reusable assistant AI/provider and NDJSON streaming helpers.
Framework integration: Exports reusable assistant validators, path helpers, query keys, and stream/settings events.
Advanced native host: Original Codex event classification, text, status and identity helpers, thread-history projections and context-refresh facts.
Advanced native host: Original detached-turn watcher and status predicates, plus Codex run, receipt, observation, goal, steering, control, scoped-turn and renewal coordination.
Advanced native host: Original OpenCode loopback client, bounded response and assistant text helpers, plus native history retirement.
Advanced native host: Claude native transcript reading, storage inventory and authorized history retirement.
Advanced native host: Claude command and account-query configuration, owned process startup and verified cleanup.
Advanced native host: Original Claude admission, streaming, background-task completion, goals, steering and private renewal execution.
Advanced native host: Codex model and account configuration with verified Helper isolation for existing native hosts.
Advanced native host: Codex shared runtime acquisition, process leadership, verified retirement and recovery for managed execution hosts.
Advanced native host: OpenCode authorized history projections, structured results and bounded renewal for existing hosts.
Advanced native host: OpenCode shared runtime selection, native plugin environment, owned server lifecycle, credential-free catalogue reads and bounded API-key verification for existing hosts.
Advanced native host: Exact native provider routes, engine configuration facts and qualified model capabilities; applications choose which models to offer.
Advanced native host: Original Codex provider acquisition, thread selection, control, recovery, native history retirement and private renewal identity operations.
Testing: Reusable checks for application conversation storage adapters.
Testing: Shared native retirement sequence retained for isolated archive and deletion-contract fixtures; native host integrations normally call their engine-specific retirement owner.
Testing: Original Codex client, history-adapter, event and model-catalogue probes for isolated host tests; tests own endpoints, authorization and cleanup.
Testing: Original OpenCode loopback client for isolated host integration tests; tests own endpoints, authorization and cleanup.
Advanced native host: Original Codex JSON-RPC client and endpoint socket-path helper; hosts retain authorization, transport limits and native lifecycle coordination.
Optional UI: Original text submission helper forwards companion text through the application draft and canonical send action; also exported by ./client/conversation.
